body_markdown:
MRAM a ‘must’ for Raven Bus GEO satellite mission


Image


stephanie.quinn


Fri, 28 Aug 2026 - 13:21


In this Silicon Semiconductor interview, Sean Dougherty, Vice President of Worldwide Sales & Marketing at Everspin Technologies, joins editor Phil Alsop to discuss Astro Digital’s selection of PERSYST 64Mb STT-MRAM for an upcoming Raven bus geosynchronous Earth orbit (GEO) satellite mission.


Sean explains why MRAM is well suited as persistent, non-volatile memory for critical boot, recovery and storage functions in long-duration space missions, and how the technology could play a broader role in mission-critical applications that depend on reliable access to data.


[Watch the full interview on Silicon Semiconductor](https://siliconsemiconductor.net/video/980/MRAM_a_%E2%80%98must%E2%80%99_for_Raven_Bus_GEO_satellite_mission)
